content: Hey love, I couldn't stop thinking about you last night. You make everything feel possible, you know that? How was your day at work?
Aw, you're so sweet. My day was okay, just super busy as usual. Honestly, talking to you is the best part of my day.
That means a lot to me. I just want us to start our new life together as soon as possible. I keep imagining us having coffee together in the mornings - no more lonely nights for either of us.
That sounds perfect. I wish it could happen sooner. It feels like all I do is work and come home to an empty apartment.

Well, I have some amazing news. I found this beautiful apartment today - it's just what we talked about, with that extra space for your art, and it's in a quiet area. I instantly thought of us there together.
Wait, seriously? That sounds incredible! Where is it?

It's in the city, close to both our work, and it has this lovely view. The only thing is, there's a high demand, and the owner wants a deposit today to secure it. I don't want us to miss out - it feels like fate, honestly.
Wow, that's so exciting. But do you think it's really that urgent? I just want to make sure it's legit.

I totally understand your concern. I spoke to the owner myself, she's very professional and sent all the paperwork. I wouldn't bring this to you if I wasn't sure, trust me. I care about us too much to risk anything.
I trust you, I just get nervous about big decisions. How much is the deposit?

It's $2,000 to secure it, and it goes toward our first month. I can cover half, but I need help with the rest since my funds are tied up in a contract until next week. Could you send $1,000? We'll finally have our place together.
That's a lot, but I want this for us. How should I send it?

Thank you, love. You're making my dreams come true. The owner prefers Zelle for speed. You can send it to her at julie.m.homes@gmail.com. Please let me know as soon as you send it, so I can confirm with her before anyone else gets it.
Okay, I'll log in and try to send it now. Just want to double-check, is it definitely safe?
Absolutely. I've checked everything, and the paperwork is all in order. I promise, I would never put you at risk. We're in this together, always.
Alright, I'm sending it now. Let me know when you get the confirmation.
Thank you so much. You have no idea how much this means to me. I can't wait to start this new chapter with you, just us, finally.
Me too. I really hope this works out. I'll send you the screenshot as soon as it goes through.
You're incredible. Once I get the confirmation, I'll ask the owner to send us the lease. We're so close, love. If you need any help with Zelle, let me know.
Thanks. My bank's taking a minute, but I should have it done soon.
No worries, take your time. I appreciate you so much. I'll handle everything else and make sure we get those keys. I love you.
